title: 21shares Announces 1-for-10 Reverse Share Split for 21Shares 2x Long Sui ETF (TXXS)
body: 21Shares today launches 2x Long Sui ETF (TXXS) on Nasdaq, the first U.S. leveraged Sui exposure, targeting 200% of SUIâs daily performance.

questions.question: Is this the issuer's own cash, paper, or control — not a sector story?
questions.note: Reverse split reduces outstanding shares by ~90%, increasing per-share NAV and price but diluting liquidity and increasing volatility risk for leveraged crypto ETFs, acting as a scarce input constraint for retail investors.

questions.question: If it is a routine dividend, why is there no 0-1d sector trade?
questions.note: Not applicable; this is not a routine dividend.

questions.question: Who is the named issuer on the Finviz hit list?
questions.note: No sector trade or named issuer on Finviz hit list provided.
